name: LRU Cache Management for Voxel Bricks
definition: A cache management strategy for voxel bricks that prioritizes reusing data not used for the longest time to optimize memory reuse while keeping useful data.
summary: LRU Cache Management for Voxel Bricks is a memory strategy that retains recently accessed voxel bricks to optimize rendering, distinguished by its CPU-managed state tracking to bypass GPU shader write limitations.
